newsitem.title: USA: Netanyahu, Arafat talk for nearly three hours.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu, Arafat talk for nearly three hours.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu conferred for nearly three hours on Middle East crisis issues on Tuesday when a lunch turned into marathon bilateral talks.

Arafat and Netanyahu, invited to a Middle East summit by U.S. President Bill Clinton, began one-to-one discussions over lunch at the White House at about 2:30 p.m. EDT (1830 GMT) and concluded at about 5:20 p.m. EDT (2120 GMT), U.S. officials said. Results were not immediately disclosed. The summit was continuing through Wednesday.
